description: This file declares the ControlClientServerInternal class, which implements the IControlClientServerInternal interface for IPC control in the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for notifying application state and pinging, and holds private members for control ID and IPC client reference.

classes.name: ControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: Implementation of IControlClientServerInternal for IPC control, managing application state notifications and ping messages.

methods.name: ControlClientServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing control ID and IPC client reference.

methods.description: Notify the application of a new application state.
